creators.name: Andrej Karpathy

description.it: Ex OpenAI e Tesla. Costruisce i modelli da zero davanti alla telecamera: le sue lezioni sono il riferimento per capire come funziona davvero un LLM.
description.en: Formerly at OpenAI and Tesla. He builds models from scratch on camera: his lectures are the reference for understanding how an LLM actually works.

creators.assessment: Included at the top of the ranking. Publishes rarely, every video is a primary reference on the subject.

creators.name: 3Blue1Brown

description.it: Matematica spiegata con animazioni costruite su misura. La serie sulle reti neurali e sui transformer è il miglior punto di partenza visivo esistente.
description.en: Mathematics explained through purpose-built animation. The series on neural networks and transformers is the best visual starting point available.

creators.assessment: Included. Low frequency, extremely high value; the scoring already favours depth over volume.

creators.name: Salvatore Sanfilippo

description.it: Autore di Redis. Ragiona ad alta voce su codice, algoritmi e modelli, spesso mostrando esperimenti reali invece di opinioni. Canale bilingue italiano e inglese.
description.en: The author of Redis. He thinks out loud about code, algorithms and models, usually showing real experiments rather than opinions. The channel is bilingual, Italian and English.

creators.assessment: Included with a high technical score. Source type stays 'creator': he is a primary source only on his own projects.

creators.name: Yannic Kilcher

description.it: Legge e commenta i paper riga per riga, con giudizi critici anche quando il lavoro è molto pubblicizzato.
description.en: Reads and annotates papers line by line, and stays critical even when the work is heavily promoted.

creators.assessment: Included. Occasionally opinionated, which is flagged by the source type, not penalised.

creators.name: Machine Learning Street Talk

description.it: Interviste lunghe a ricercatori, con discussioni tecniche che non vengono semplificate per il pubblico generalista.
description.en: Long-form interviews with researchers, with technical discussions that are not simplified for a general audience.

creators.assessment: Included as podcast. Episodes are long: valuable, but not breaking news.

creators.name: Welch Labs

description.it: Video rari e molto curati, con visualizzazioni originali su matematica e reti neurali.
description.en: Rare, highly crafted videos with original visualisations of mathematics and neural networks.

creators.assessment: Included. Very low publishing frequency; kept because the quality justifies it.

creators.name: Computerphile

description.it: Informatica spiegata da ricercatori universitari. Ideale per la sezione curiosità tecniche.
description.en: Computer science explained by university researchers. A natural fit for the tech curiosities desk.

creators.assessment: Included. Perfect match for the 'how does it actually work' section.

creators.name: StatQuest

description.it: Statistica e machine learning spiegati passo per passo, senza saltare i passaggi intermedi.
description.en: Statistics and machine learning explained step by step, without skipping the intermediate steps.

creators.assessment: Included. Foundational rather than topical: scored for depth, not freshness.

creators.name: In Depth Cine

description.it: Analisi della fotografia di film specifici: scelte di ottica, luce e formato spiegate con riferimenti alle interviste ai direttori della fotografia.
description.en: Analysis of the cinematography of specific films: lens, lighting and format choices explained with reference to interviews with the DPs.

creators.assessment: Included with a high score. One of the few channels that cites its sources on craft decisions.

creators.name: Cinematography Database

description.it: Matt Workman lavora sul punto di contatto fra fotografia cinematografica e motori 3D: previz, virtual production e simulazione della luce in Unreal.
description.en: Matt Workman works at the meeting point of cinematography and 3D engines: previz, virtual production and light simulation in Unreal.

creators.assessment: Included. Covers a niche — previz and virtual production for DPs — that no written source in this list covers well.

creators.name: wolfcrow

description.it: Tecnica di ripresa e post spiegata con numeri: codec, spazi colore, gamma dinamica, workflow.
description.en: Shooting and post technique explained with numbers: codecs, colour spaces, dynamic range, workflow.

creators.assessment: Included. Among the most rigorous channels on colour and codecs.

creators.name: This Guy Edits

description.it: Sven Pape è un montatore professionista e analizza il montaggio di film reali mostrando le alternative scartate. È la fonte più vicina alla rubrica di montaggio di questa piattaforma.
description.en: Sven Pape is a working editor who breaks down the cutting of real films and shows the alternatives that were discarded. The closest source to this platform's editing column.

creators.assessment: Included with a high score. Rare case of a practising editor explaining decisions rather than software.

creators.name: Dwarkesh Patel

description.it: Interviste preparate con cura a ricercatori e dirigenti del settore. Domande informate, non promozionali.
description.en: Carefully prepared interviews with researchers and industry leaders. Informed questions, not promotional ones.

creators.assessment: Included as podcast.

creators.name: AI Explained

description.it: Analisi delle release di modelli basata su test propri e lettura dei system card, invece che sui comunicati.
description.en: Analysis of model releases based on his own testing and on reading the system cards, rather than on press releases.

creators.assessment: Included. Cites sources and runs his own evaluations — unusual in this niche.

creators.name: Enkk

description.it: Divulgatore italiano su AI e LLM, con un taglio dichiaratamente anti-hype: spiega cosa i modelli fanno davvero e cosa no. Fra le poche fonti in italiano su questi temi con questo livello di attenzione.
description.en: Italian educator on AI and LLMs with a deliberately anti-hype stance: he explains what models actually do and what they do not. One of very few Italian-language sources on these topics at this level of care.

creators.assessment: Included. Rare combination: Italian language, technical accuracy and no hype. Weighted as creator, never as primary source.

creators.name: Corridor Crew

description.it: Artisti VFX che analizzano effetti di film reali e rifanno le stesse tecniche mostrando il procedimento.
description.en: VFX artists who break down effects from real films and rebuild the same techniques on camera.

creators.assessment: Included. Entertainment format, but the technical content is genuine and verifiable.

creators.name: bycloud

description.it: Riassunti di paper recenti con un buon livello tecnico e un montaggio veloce.
description.en: Summaries of recent papers at a decent technical level, edited fast.

creators.assessment: Included with a moderate score: technically solid, occasionally leans on hype framing in titles.

creators.name: StudioBinder

description.it: Video saggi sul linguaggio cinematografico, ben montati e didatticamente ordinati.
description.en: Video essays on film language, well edited and pedagogically organised.

creators.assessment: Included. Commercial channel attached to a software product, which is stated openly.

creators.name: Film Riot

description.it: Tutorial pratici su effetti, ripresa e post per produzioni a basso budget.
description.en: Practical tutorials on effects, shooting and post for low-budget productions.

creators.assessment: Included in the tutorials category.

creators.name: Fireship

description.it: Video brevissimi su novità di programmazione e strumenti. Efficace come segnale, non come approfondimento.
description.en: Very short videos on programming news and tools. Effective as a signal, not as depth.

creators.assessment: Included with a low technical score: excellent format, deliberately superficial by design.

creators.name: No Film School

description.it: Versione video della testata: interviste e guide pratiche.
description.en: The video arm of the publication: interviews and practical guides.

creators.assessment: Included, but weighted below the written outlet which is better edited.

creators.name: Sebastian Kamph

description.it: Tutorial su workflow locali di generazione immagini e video.
description.en: Tutorials on local image and video generation workflows.

creators.assessment: Included in tutorials.

creators.name: Theoretically Media

description.it: Prove pratiche dei modelli video dal punto di vista di chi fa filmmaking, con giudizi misurati.
description.en: Hands-on testing of video models from a filmmaker's perspective, with measured verdicts.

creators.assessment: Included. One of the more level-headed channels in the AI video niche.

creators.name: Curious Refuge

description.it: Workflow completi di AI filmmaking. Da tenere presente che promuove corsi a pagamento propri.
description.en: Complete AI filmmaking workflows. Worth noting that it promotes its own paid courses.

creators.assessment: Included with the commercial interest noted in the description, not hidden.

creators.name: Olivio Sarikas

description.it: Workflow ComfyUI e modelli locali, aggiornati molto rapidamente a ogni nuova release.
description.en: ComfyUI workflows and local models, updated very quickly after each new release.

creators.assessment: Included with a moderate score: high volume, quick production, occasionally shallow.

creators.name: MattVidPro AI

description.it: Panoramiche sugli strumenti AI. Copertura ampia e rapida, profondità tecnica limitata.
description.en: Overviews of AI tools. Broad and fast coverage, limited technical depth.

creators.assessment: Included with a deliberately low score: useful as a signal of what is new, not as a technical reference. The hype penalty in the scoring will push the more sensational titles down on its own.
